articles.title: Tropical Storm Isaias Heads Toward the U.S. Gulf Coast
articles.summary: Tropical Storm Isaias is expected to become a hurricane and reach the U.S. Gulf Coast late Friday or early Saturday, and communities are getting ready.

articles.title: Georgia's Governor Candidates Meet for Their Only TV Debate
articles.summary: Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms and Republican Rick Jackson, who are running for governor of Georgia, answered voters' questions in their only televised debate.

articles.title: Police Surveillance Software Is Growing, and Experts Are Debating It
articles.summary: More police departments are using AI software that combines camera feeds and data in one place, and privacy experts are raising questions about it.
